what: While a long panel (about 400vh) stays pinned, a square wheel rolls from off the left edge to the right edge — the road is a series of catenary (cosh) arches, one per wheel side length, so the angular wheel rolls without jolting, and over the first 30% of progress the sides grow from 4 to 12 and for the rest it swells into a circle while the road flattens (smoothstep). It rotates by the distance rolled, with 5·10 dotted lines at axle height and a 3px dot in the center. The first 25% of scroll progress is a rest, and values follow along by .2 per frame

options.to: Last side count before it becomes a circle, default 12
options.radius: Wheel radius (relative to the panel’s short side), default .13
options.phase: Share of sides that grow (the rest become a circle), default .3
options.margin: Bottom margin that sets the path height (px), default 360

use:
…
(line color is the stage’s color — for a white line on a red cell, color: var(--kf-contrast-ink))
note: stage is position: sticky; top: 0; Set to height: 100vh (fx.css). The canvas is created if missing

from.where: index.html .nl-roll (process 400vh) — original pw-canvas: N 4→12, PHASE2 .3, R = min(W,H)·.13 (×1.2 on phones), SCROLL_OFFSET .25, SMOOTHING .2, BOTTOM_MARGIN 360, catenary path, dashed [5,10]
